sample_note: deterministic random sample fraction=0.175978, capped at 120000

distributed_vs_reference.note: ARI on all evaluated events; core-point ARI isolates border-assignment ambiguity. Border points reachable from two clusters may legitimately receive different labels.

reference_declustering_note: Simplified magnitude-window reference (Gardner–Knopoff-style L(M), T(M)); it is not the full published GK algorithm and its labels are not ground truth.

environment.note: Spark local mode on one machine, not a multi-node cluster.

limitations: Cluster labels are arbitrary; ARI compares partitions, not semantic identities.
The distributed merge is driver-side Union–Find over local cluster links.
K-Means ignores time and uses 3-D unit vectors; it is not a space–time method.
Parameter sensitivity is computed with the single-machine reference on a bounded sample.
